set.body: P1.07 deferral. Nifti.readVolume/readSeries, NiftiHeader.space and SampleSpaces.make still place geometry in WorldSpace.Unresolved (scalafim-ras-d3), so legacy-read volumes align across subjects and templates, including in the viewer. Move dataset ingest, viewers and examples onto Nifti.readVolumeIn/readSeriesIn with SpaceEvidence, then retire the shared Unresolved key. See ADR spatial-transforms.md §8 and the plan's Phase 1 section.
set.title: STP follow-up: move legacy NIfTI readers onto readVolumeIn (world identity)
